description: IPC for the Lưu trữ (archive) window: the four read-only archive commands plus core:default and the window-close permission it needs. No remote, no account/lock/settings/notification permissions; per-command authorization is also enforced in Rust (archive_cmds::read_guard checks the caller label + app lock). The remote Zalo page gets nothing from this set, and settings gains only allow-archive-open.
